methodology.description: Annual agricultural asset-value benchmarks drawn from official Land Values tables and the current official Quick Stats download. These are survey-based estimated values, not individual parcel transactions.
methodology.units: Nominal US dollars per acre; not inflation-adjusted.
methodology.revisionPolicy: 2010–2013 use the 2014 final-estimates bulletin; 2014–2018 use the 2019 final-estimates bulletin; 2019 uses the current Quick Stats final estimates. 2020, 2021, and 2022–2026 use the 2024, 2025, and 2026 annual reports respectively. All extracted numeric report values were cross-checked against the 2026-10-01 Quick Stats economics download. Newer selected report suppression takes precedence over an earlier numeric publication.
caveats: Farm real estate includes farm buildings and dwellings. It is not a benchmark for unimproved vacant land alone.
Values are statewide or national agricultural survey estimates, not asking prices, closed-sale comparables, parcel appraisals or an automated valuation model.
All dollars are nominal. Historical changes do not remove inflation or differences in land quality, improvements, access, rights, use or location.
Alaska and Hawaii are excluded from these land-value state tables and from the national aggregate.

Earlier reports group some Northeast states as Other States. Individual values for those states are null; a group average is never assigned to each state. (D) values are also null and are explicitly labeled withheld.
Arizona, Nevada, New Mexico and Utah estimates exclude American Indian Reservation land.

Survey methods and reporting coverage changed over this history. The 2021 report describes the June Area Survey; the 2026 report describes the Agricultural Land Values Survey collected April–June. Interpret changes with the source vintage and methodology.
National and regional agricultural estimates use acreage-based weighting; the national number is not the simple mean of the displayed states.
The most recent annual estimates may be revised in later USDA publications. This is a dated source snapshot, not a live Quick Stats connection.

metrics.label: Pasture
